candidates.source_description:
In 1999, one of the most unforgettable moments in Star Wars history and Hollywood movie history took place when thousands of fans gathered for the midnight premiere of Star Wars: Episode I – The Phantom Menace. This rare footage captures the excitement, enormous crowds, and incredible anticipation surrounding one of the biggest movie releases of the 1990s.
